content: Conversational UI literature: the single most consistent chatbot failure mode is shipping the 'happy path' free-text parse and adding fallback/clarification handling later; production systems need the fallback layer (ask a clarifying question, offer a related-question suggestion, graceful handoff) designed in from the start, because real user phrasing breaks naive intent parsing immediately. Buttons existed specifically to make intent unambiguous; removing them pushes that ambiguity into the model and the conversation design.
